body.message:
1.	I would actually need the studio for a longer stay — ideally from arrival until June, so approximately 9 months. Is there a long-term rate available for a stay of this length, or would the September rate advertised on Property Finder still apply for a booking of this duration?
	2.	My arrival date would be around the 10th–11th of October rather than the 7th. Could the booking period be adjusted accordingly?
	3.	For a stay of this length, I would prefer to pay on a monthly basis rather than upfront for multiple months — i.e. the AED 1,000 security deposit as requested, followed by monthly rent payments for each subsequent month. Is this option available, or is upfront payment (first month + last month + deposit) mandatory for long-term bookings? If monthly payment is possible, could you confirm whether the rate would stay fixed for the whole 9-month period?

Once I have these details confirmed in writing, I'll be happy to proceed.

Thank you!
